principle: Real events are coupled: every layer shares the same air and ground. A missing reaction BETWEEN layers is the durable tell; pixel artifacts get fixed first as generators improve.

statuses.OBSERVED: the cue is drawn from field-observation practice; someone who has watched real events uses it
statuses.SECONDARY: the cue or its mechanism rests on a cited secondary source, carried here and not verified in this environment
statuses.DERIVED: the cue follows from stated physics (shared air, shared ground, one light source) and has no field or literature source of its own
statuses.PROPOSED: a candidate cue with neither a field baseline nor a mechanism source; included so it can be tested, not because it is established

answers.yes: the layer is visible and it reacts the way a real event would
answers.no: the layer is VISIBLE and the expected reaction is absent or contradicted. Do not answer no when the layer is not in frame.
answers.cannot_see: the layer is not in frame, the frame is too tight, the audio is stripped, or you cannot tell. Never counts against the clip.

cues.question: Do birds scatter in irregular takeoff BEFORE the event is visible (water, shaking, blast)?
cues.expected_if_real: panic flush, many directions, before the visible arrival
cues.typical_if_generated: calm formation (a perfect V), birds that never react, or birds that react only after the visible event

mechanism.claim: birds hear infrasound and feel ground vibration ahead of the visible event
mechanism.source: Kreithen & Quine 1979, J Comp Physiol 129:1-4 (infrasound detection in pigeons); Streby et al. 2015, Curr Biol (warblers evacuating ahead of storms). Both carried from the dispatch, not read here.

cues.question: Do dogs, livestock or other animals turn, bolt or freeze BEFORE the people around them react?
cues.expected_if_real: animals react first; people look at the animals, then toward the event
cues.typical_if_generated: animals stand still, graze, or react in step with the people or after them

mechanism.claim: ground vibration and infrasound reach animals before the event is visible to people
mechanism.source: no citation supplied; same physics as C-BIRD-1, not independently sourced

cues.question: Are trees shaken from the BASE (ground-driven) rather than swaying from the crown (wind-driven)?
cues.expected_if_real: trunk and base move with the ground; crown lags; motion is jerky and shares the shake
cues.typical_if_generated: smooth crown sway with a still trunk, or trees that do not move while the ground does

mechanism.claim: ground motion enters a tree at the roots; wind enters at the crown
mechanism.source: physics of the load path; no field or literature source

cues.question: Do all trees, flags, smoke and loose debris lean or move in ONE consistent wind direction?
cues.expected_if_real: one wind direction across the frame, changing together when gusts change
cues.typical_if_generated: trees swaying in different directions, or trees still while flags and smoke move

mechanism.claim: everything in one frame sits in one wind field
mechanism.source: physics; no field or literature source

cues.question: Do people turn toward the event BEFORE it reaches them?
cues.expected_if_real: heads turn toward the sound or the shake first; running starts after the turn
cues.typical_if_generated: people keep walking or looking at the camera until the event is on top of them, or every person reacts on the same frame
cues.source: dispatch GLYPH-C1 (listed without a status; sound and vibration precede the visible arrival)

mechanism.claim: people hear and feel the event before they see it
mechanism.source: physics; no field or literature source

cues.question: Does people's movement track the event (stumble on the shake, brace at the blast, wade at water speed)?
cues.expected_if_real: bodies react to the same forces the ground and air show
cues.typical_if_generated: people move as if on flat, still ground while everything around them shakes or flows

mechanism.claim: a body in the scene is loaded by the same ground and air as the rest of the scene
mechanism.source: physics; no field or literature source

cues.question: Do objects keep existing (nothing appears, vanishes, or un-flips between frames)?
cues.expected_if_real: objects persist; a car that flips stays flipped; debris carried away stays gone
cues.typical_if_generated: objects appear or vanish, text and logos change, a flipped object rights itself
cues.source: fact-check practice; the dispatch cites the Nepal 2026 fakes, not verified here

mechanism.claim: a generator renders each frame from a prototype and does not conserve objects across frames
mechanism.source: fact-check practice (dispatch GLYPH-C1); no primary citation

cues.question: Is there ONE light direction across all objects and all frames?
cues.expected_if_real: shadows agree with each other and with the sun or the lamps in frame
cues.typical_if_generated: shadows pointing different ways, objects with no shadow, light direction drifting between frames

mechanism.claim: a scene under one sun has one shadow direction; layers rendered separately need not
mechanism.source: physics; no field or literature source

cues.question: Does the water CARRY material (mud, debris, colour) rather than solids dissolving into it?
cues.expected_if_real: brown, loaded water; debris rides the surface at flow speed
cues.typical_if_generated: clear water over dirt, solids that melt or blur into the flow, debris that hangs still on moving water

mechanism.claim: moving water entrains what it passes over; it does not dissolve wood or stone
mechanism.source: physics; no field or literature source

cues.question: Does floating debris move WITH the flow, at the flow's speed and direction?
cues.expected_if_real: debris, foam and people in the water all travel together
cues.typical_if_generated: debris drifting against the flow, faster or slower than the water, or two flow directions in one frame

mechanism.claim: one flow field carries everything in it
mechanism.source: physics; no field or literature source

cues.question: Does dust or smoke rise FROM the impact point and then drift the same way the trees and flags lean?
cues.expected_if_real: a plume rooted at the source, drifting downwind with everything else
cues.typical_if_generated: a plume with no source, dust that appears everywhere at once, or smoke drifting against the wind the trees show

mechanism.claim: dust is lofted where energy enters the ground and then rides the shared wind
mechanism.source: physics; no field or literature source

cues.question: At a distance, does the sound arrive AFTER the visible flash or collapse, with a longer delay the farther away it is?
cues.expected_if_real: light first, sound later; about three seconds per kilometre
cues.typical_if_generated: sound exactly on the visible frame at any distance, or a boom with no visible source

mechanism.claim: sound travels at roughly 340 m/s in air; light is effectively instant
mechanism.source: physics; no field or literature source

cues.question: Does the CAMERA itself shake when the ground does (a handheld phone on a shaking floor cannot stay steady)?
cues.expected_if_real: the frame jolts with the ground; a tripod or a fixed camera shows the room move as one
cues.typical_if_generated: a perfectly steady handheld frame while everything inside it shakes

mechanism.claim: the recorder stands on the same ground as the scene
mechanism.source: physics; no field or literature source

cues.question: Do rain streaks, spray, debris and trees all show the same wind direction, and change together in gusts?
cues.expected_if_real: one wind across every layer, gusting together
cues.typical_if_generated: vertical rain in a storm that bends the trees sideways, or spray moving against the trees

mechanism.source: physics; no field or literature source

cues.question: Do flames, the smoke column and flying embers all lean the same way, downwind of the trees?
cues.expected_if_real: flames, smoke and embers agree with the wind the trees show
cues.typical_if_generated: flames leaning one way and smoke another, embers falling straight down in a wind, or a plume that ignores the trees

mechanism.claim: one wind field carries flame, smoke and ember alike
mechanism.source: physics; no field or literature source

cues.question: Are animals moving AWAY from the fire front, ahead of the flames rather than beside or toward them?
cues.expected_if_real: movement away from the front, ahead of it
cues.typical_if_generated: animals grazing beside the flames, or moving toward them
cues.source: no field baseline and no citation supplied; included to be tested

mechanism.claim: heat and smoke are aversive and arrive ahead of the flame front
